A processing service may use only one foundation service and no higher-level service.

Back to STXP rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A processing service may use only one foundation service and no higher-level service. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Processing services family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXP001: A processing service may use only one foundation service and no higher-level service.
class StudentProcessingService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseService courses) : IStudentProcessingService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXP001
class StudentProcessingService(IStudentService students) : IStudentProcessingService { }
